diagnosis.definition: The reply gives a plausible answer but leaves out the artifact the task contract requires: a bracketed policy citation such as [P-02], or a ticket ID from a create_ticket call. It cites the policy in plain text or not at all, or it offers troubleshooting or asks permission instead of creating the ticket.

In a security incident response (phishing, lost laptop, compromised account), the assistant opens a ticket and gives steps but omits the required escalation contact address security@acme.example from its answer.
When a policy search returns no relevant result, the assistant tells the user to contact HR or another team itself and never calls create_ticket to escalate the unanswered question.
The assistant gives a correct policy-based answer but omits the required bracketed citation tag (e.g. "[P-08]") demanded by the answer format, mentioning the policy only in plain prose.
